license_model: MIT OSS components + commercial Memory API (usage-based SM tokens)
primary_use_cases: Memory API and context infrastructure for AI agents; RAG over user documents; cross-app memory graph; connector-synced knowledge
deployment_options: Cloud API (supermemory.ai), self-host Docker option (2025 changelog), TypeScript/Python SDKs, MCP server
pricing_summary: Free tier; paid tiers $0.005–$0.10 per 1K SM tokens by operation type
integration_model: REST API + SDKs; AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, n8n, Zapier; explicit add/search — not zero-code LLM interceptor
storage_backends: Proprietary vector graph engine; cloud-managed; container/tag scoping for memories
memory_tiers: Episodic, semantic, procedural memory types in product docs; User Profiles layer auto-built from behavior
graph_model: Memory Graph with ontology-aware edges; handles updates, merges, contradictions, inferences; interactive graph viz in MCP (2026)
multi_tenant_model: containerTag, project keys, multi-containerTag scoped API keys (2026 changelog)
extraction_approach: Smart chunking + multimodal extractors (PDF, web, images, audio/video with transcription)
update_operations: Graph merge and contradiction handling at ingest; ontology-aware edge updates
consolidation_strategy: Managed platform pipeline; profile synthesis from behavioral signals
temporal_model: Event and document timestamps; graph versioning for knowledge updates — less explicit bi-temporal than Zep
agent_fact_handling: Ingests user and agent content via API; behavior-derived profiles
retrieval_signals: Hybrid vector + keyword; sub-300ms claimed latency; context-aware reranking
latency_profile: Sub-300ms hybrid search claimed; 76.7% multi-session accuracy cited in AI SDK guide
token_efficiency: Selective retrieval vs full document context; SM token metering
multimodal_support: PDF, PPTX, web, images, audio (Gemini 2.5 Flash transcription), video
connectors: Notion, Slack, Google Drive, S3, Gmail auto-sync; ViaSocket and others in 2026
user_profiles: Automatic User Profiles from behavior — intent, preferences, context
procedural_memory: Procedural memory type supported in long-term memory guide
framework_integrations: AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, Claude Code, OpenAI SDK, n8n, Zapier, MCP
locomo_scores: [uncertain] — not primary published metric in public docs reviewed
benchmark_methodology: Product benchmarks cited in blog posts; not same open harness as Mem0 memory-benchmarks
stated_unsolved_problems: Enterprise scale pricing predictability; deep self-host parity with cloud graph features
public_roadmap: CLI, Console v2, removed 120-memory cap, PPTX/audio ingest, MCP graph visualization (changelog 2025–2026)
known_limitations: API-first (no interceptor); commercial dependency for full graph; token-based billing complexity
memorable_has: Optional graph toggle; hybrid retrieval concept; relationship heuristics in NetworkX
memorable_lacks: Ontology-aware graph, multimodal ingest, connectors, user profiles, managed-scale hybrid search, SaaS DX
memorable_should_port: Graph contradiction/merge patterns; connector plugin architecture (C5); smart chunking for documents; profile layer optional module
memorable_should_skip: Full proprietary graph engine rebuild; SM token commercial model
priority_for_memorable: P2 (graph UX P1 partial; multimodal/connectors P2–P3)
